text:
maria: FYI vendor CSV landed from Nebula — attaching snippet. Need to fold into cost model before Friday.

devon: can you paste the key rows? don't want to open attachments in slack.

maria: pasted key rows below so we can iterate without the attachment:
```
region,sku,commit_months,reserved_discount,spot_disk_count,eviction_window_minutes,latency_premium_ms
us-west,nebula-p4,12,0.35,0.6,15,7
us-east,nebula-p4,1,0.10,0.3,5,5
eu-central,nebula-a100,6,0.20,0.5,20,10
```

akshay: interesting — reserved discounts are front-loaded at 12m which helps long-term unit cost. but eviction_window varies a lot. suggest modeling two spot buckets: short-evict (<10m) and long-evict (>=10m) with probability curves.

corey: also note spot_disk_count is basically an availability proxy — 0.6 means ~60% of peak slots available. we should translate that into an effective throughput factor in the batcher sim (not a direct multiply for cost since batching efficiency changes).

maria: thinking of these assumptions: commit conversion_rate=0.6 for 12m offers, spot_avail sampled per 5m window using spot_disk_count, latency_premium applied additively when we spill to spot-backed instances. any objections?

devon: fine. for pricing sensitivity, can we run scenarios: base (vendor numbers), conservative (spot -20%, reserved uptake -10%), optimistic (spot +15%, reserved uptake +10%). i'll feed scenario defs to the modeler.

akshay: +1. also add a fallback cold-start penalty for long-eviction slots (eviction_window_minutes >= 10). placeholder cost +$0.15 / 1k tokens for any request that hits cold-starts due to eviction. we'll refine after sim.

maria: cool. @infra-bot can you queue a run on cost-sim with these scenarios + the new Nebula CSV? tag results here when ready :thumbsup: 

infra-bot: queued cost-sim:nebula-2400001111 — scenarios: base, conservative, optimistic. ETA ~2h. artifacts -> https://ci.internal/runs/nebula-2400001111

corey: once we have the output, let's map sim units to Marketplace listing SKUs and check crediting windows (billing alignment). small ops note: confirm commit proration behavior for partial-month starts — that changes effective per-hour unit.

maria: noted. i'll capture the mapping in the pricing sheet and spin up a short doc for partner meeting. if numbers look good we can propose a deeper 18m incentive in the next round and call out the eviction SLA tradeoffs.

devon: ack. i'll prepare sensitivity chart and a quick one-pager for Friday's partner sync.
